import html
from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify, unique

# Test with escaped character
inner_html = 'escaped\x0295\x03character'  # STX + 95 + ETX
print(f"inner_html repr: {repr(inner_html)}")

# What does html.unescape do?
unescaped = html.unescape(inner_html)
print(f"After html.unescape: {repr(unescaped)}")

# What does slugify produce?
slug = slugify(unescaped, '_')
print(f"Slug: {repr(slug)}")
